coverage_definition.eligibility_policy: Only final action groups with selection_status=eligible may be selected; excluded, quarantined, and unresolved groups are fail-closed.
coverage_definition.supply_rule: A selected action supplies a requirement when it contains the identical or one directly confirmed equivalent canonical capability in the same domain at a level greater than or equal to the target requirement.
coverage_definition.target_rule: An action is covered when every requirement in the mode's required capability domains is supplied by the selected portfolio.
coverage_definition.zero_requirement_policy: An action with no requirements in the active mode is vacuously covered.

reporting.joint_batch_rule: Actions selected by k1, k2.1, or k2.2 form an unordered joint batch; stable display order is not a claim of greedy entry.
required_outputs: 100 selected action groups per mode with tier provenance and rationale
economic, strategic, STEM, SOC, occupation, action, and capability-family coverage
reporting.sequential_rule: k3, k4, and k5 report their actual frozen sequential selection step and active unit.

tiers.candidate_rule: Eligible unselected actions with positive market-work economic value.
lexicographic_objective: maximize total covered paid-work economic mass
holding covered mass within the frozen solver tolerance, minimize the sum of final action-group indices
tiers.target_view: All economic_value policy units aggregated without double-counting their separately sourced action allocations.

tiers.candidate_rule: Eligible unselected actions with positive mass in at least one strategic_domain_breadth policy unit.
lexicographic_objective: maximize the minimum absolute coverage fraction across healthcare, education, protective services, and transportation
holding the maximin optimum, maximize total normalized covered strategic mass
holding both substantive optima, minimize the sum of final action-group indices
tiers.selection_method: Exact joint MILP conditioned on every earlier selection.

tiers.candidate_rule: Eligible unselected actions with positive mass in at least one stem_research_breadth policy unit.
lexicographic_objective: maximize the minimum absolute coverage fraction across Architecture and Engineering, Computer and Mathematical, and Life, Physical, and Social Science
holding the maximin optimum, maximize total normalized covered STEM/research mass
holding both substantive optima, minimize the sum of final action-group indices
tiers.selection_method: Exact joint MILP conditioned on every earlier selection.

candidate_order: maximize marginal covered economic mass inside the active SOC group
break ties by marginal global economic coverage
then larger direct mass in the active group
tiers.candidate_rule: For the active SOC major group, eligible unselected actions with positive mass in that group's soc_major_breadth policy unit.
tiers.selection_method: Sequential frozen round-robin conditioned on every earlier selection.
unit_order: choose the currently least-covered SOC major group that still has a candidate
break equal coverage by larger uncovered economic mass
break remaining ties by policy-unit ID

candidate_order: maximize marginal covered economic mass inside the active occupation
break ties by marginal global economic coverage
then larger direct mass in the active occupation
tiers.candidate_rule: For the active occupation, eligible unselected actions with positive mass in that occupation and positive provenance in exactly one economic_value occupation overall.
tiers.selection_method: Sequential least-covered-occupation round-robin conditioned on every earlier selection.
unit_order: choose the currently least-covered occupation that still has a niche candidate
break equal coverage by larger uncovered economic mass
break remaining ties by policy-unit ID

candidate_order: maximize newly supplied weighted requirement incidence in the active family
break ties by marginal global economic coverage
tiers.candidate_rule: Every eligible unselected final action group that supplies positive unmet requirement incidence in the active capability family.
tiers.combined_mode_family_order: All physics families in physics_family_order, followed by all robot families in robot_family_order.
tiers.family_assignment: Each canonical capability is assigned to the first matching family in its domain's frozen order using the keyword rules embedded in the versioned implementation; unmatched names enter the domain-specific other family.
tiers.selection_method: Sequential least-covered-family fill conditioned on every earlier selection.
tiers.target_view: All final action-group requirement incidences in the mode; each action contributes total unit weight divided equally across its active-mode requirements.
unit_order: choose the currently least-covered active-mode family with positive attainable gain
break equal coverage by larger unmet family requirement weight
break remaining ties by frozen family order
